6144.name: Frigorifish
desc: The colder the water, the more this fish thrives, for it can only be found in rivers and lakes in Ulbuka that have been frozen over.

6145.name: Dwarf Remora
desc: A new hatchling from the remora, a species of fish that has managed to survive for countless eons.

6146.name: Remora
desc: A legendary fish that has bloodied the waters in which it swims since times of yore.

6147.name: Mikhe's Memo
desc: A memo scrawled by Mikhe Aryohcha that matter-of-factly states, "Just throw your fist at your opponent and it'll all work out." Adventurers say that their hand-to-hand skill increases after reading this note.

6148.name: Dgr. Enchiridion
desc: A guide to the finer points of wielding a dagger, written by an anonymous individual. Adventurers note that reading it increases one's dagger skill.

6149.name: Swing and Stab
desc: Ulla wrote this guide on sword wielding--from how to grip the hilt to tips on footwork--so others could follow in her footsteps. Adventurers note that reading it increases one's sword skill.

6150.name: Mieuseloir's Diary
desc: An account penned by Mieuseloir B Enchelles of his encounters with the Gigas in Beaucedine Glacier. Adventurers note that reading it increases one's great sword skill.

6151.name: Bull's Diary
desc: An account penned by Striking Bull during the Second Battle of Konschtat. It details the Republic's victory over King Raigegue the Lupine's San d'Orian army. Adventurers note that reading it increases one's axe skill.

6152.name: Death for Dim.
desc: A guide to the finer points of hacking everything in one's way to pieces with a two-handed axe, written by an anonymous individual. Adventurers note that reading it increases one's great axe skill.

6153.name: Ludwig's Report
desc: A report made by Ludwig Eichberg regarding the Battle of Grauberg. It details the constant changes in the position of the front line and the withdrawal of Republic troops. Adventurers note that reading it increases one's scythe skill.

6154.name: Clash of Titans
desc: An article detailing the duel between  Yrvaulair S Cousseraux and Alphonimile M Aurchiat that became all the rage in San d'Oria after appearing in a popular newspaper. Adventurers note that reading it increases one's polearm skill.

6155.name: Kagetora's Diary
desc: A diary written by Kagetora. In it he details each and every one of his ninety-eight victories and ninety-nine losses against Yomi. Adventurers note that reading it increases one's katana skill.

6156.name: Noillurie's Log
desc: A record Noillurie kept of her personal experiences. The one that stands out the most is the battle with the colossal beast she undertook to prove herself to her order. Adventurers note that reading it increases one's great katana skill.

6157.name: Ferreous's Diary
desc: A diary written by Ferreous Coffin that describes his encounters with Orcs in the north. So many were there that his war hammer became coated with a thick layer of blood after all was said and done. Adventurers note that reading it increases one's club skill.

6158.name: K-P's Memoirs
desc: Memoirs penned by Kayeel-Payeel. They describe in particular detail the time he received Claustrum from the Warlock Warlord Robel-Akbel. Adventurers note that reading them increases one's staff skill.

6159.name: Perih's Primer
desc: A guidebook Perih Vashai jotted down for the edification of new recruits. It discusses everything from the various ways of holding a bow to methods of judging distance. Adventurers note that reading it increases one's archery skill.

6160.name: Barrels of Fun
desc: An educational text authored by Elivira Gogol. It discusses how to dismantle, clean, and reconstruct firearms in careful detail. Adventurers note that reading it increases one's marksmanship skill.

6161.name: T.W. Enchiridion
desc: A guide to the finer points of hurling projectile objects at opponents, written by an anonymous individual. Adventurers note that reading it increases one's throwing skill.

6162.name: Mikhe's Note
desc: A memo scrawled by Mikhe Aryohcha that matter-of-factly states, "Just throw your guard up and it'll all work out." Adventurers note that reading it increases one's guarding skill.

6163.name: Sonia's Diary
desc: A compilation of memories from Sonia. Of particular note are her observations on how to replicate the sheer brilliance of Annika Brilioth and the esoteric steps known as the Kriegstanz. Adventurers say that reading it increases their evasion skill.

6164.name: The Successor
desc: An essay authored by Cerane I Virgaut, mainly concerning the night Perseus bequeathed unto her an exemplary shield. Adventurers note that reading it increases one's shield skill.

6165.name: Kage. Journal
desc: A journal kept by Kagetora that delineates the extent to which he and Yomi lost themselves in their studies of the martial arts. Adventurers note that reading it increases one's parrying skill.

6166.name: Altana's Hymn
desc: A copy of Febrenard C Brunnaut's favorite read. The simple lyrics and enchanting meter were said to have soothed his soul. Adventurers note that reading it increases one's divine magic skill.

6167.name: Coveffe Musings
desc: A collection of thoughts scribbled out by Ferreous Coffin on his visit to Coveffe Barrows. Adventurers note that reading it increases one's healing magic skill.

6168.name: Aid for All
desc: A guide to the finer points of heightening the potential of one's compatriots, written by Rainemard. It also includes some tips on how to swing special swords. Adventurers note that reading it increases one's enhancing magic skill.

6169.name: Inv. Report
desc: A collection of observations made by Rainemard on a particular exploration. It goes into such detail on so much minutiae that many admit to never finishing it. Adventurers note that reading it increases one's enfeebling magic skill.

6170.name: Bounty List
desc: A simple list of known criminals who are better off dead. Every single name is crossed out in Azima's handwriting. Adventurers note that reading it increases one's elemental magic skill.

6171.name: Dark Deeds
desc: A guide to the finer points of insidious dark magic, as compiled by Azima. Proceeds from this tome have gone to fund her various purchases dealing with alchemical research. Adventurers note that reading it increases one's dark magic skill.

6172.name: Breezy Libretto
desc: A musical score composed by Lewenhart. Its notes symbolize a fragrant, early morning summer breeze. Adventurers note that reading it increases one's singing skill.

6173.name: Cavernous Score
desc: A musical score composed by Lewenhart. Its notes symbolize the damp and musty air that stagnates within an underground cave. Adventurers note that reading it increases one's string instrument skill.

6174.name: Beaming Score
desc: A musical score composed by Lewenhart. Its notes symbolize the gently glowing beams of light that filter through the leaves of a deciduous tree in the late afternoon. Adventurers note that reading it increases one's wind instrument skill.

6175.name: Yomi's Diagram
desc: A meticulously drawn diagram Yomi made for Kagetora explaining how to construct certain ninja tools. Adventurers note that reading it increases one's ninjutsu skill.

6176.name: Astral Homeland
desc: A specious work written by an unknown individual that both reads and feels like an illusion from the ancient past. It discusses the world avatars inhabit, but seems too absurd to be true. Adventurers note that reading it increases one's summoning magic skill.

6177.name: Life-form Study
desc: A report written and filed by an anonymous individual. It covers the behavioral patterns and diets of almost every known family of beasts in existence. Adventurers note that reading it increases one's blue magic skill.

6178.name: Hrohj's Record
desc: A record of what happened on the fateful day the lifestream overflowed, as kept by Hrohj Wagrehsa. Adventurers note that reading it increases one's geomancy skill.

6179.name: The Bell Tolls
desc: An essay penned by Hrohj Wagrehsa concerning the transmission of Sih Renaye's handbell and the voice of the land. Adventurers note that reading it increases one's handbell skill.
